ModMetaData.name: Immersive Raid Compression
ModMetaData.author: lyj
ModMetaData.description:
Reduces oversized late-game human, mechanoid, and manhunter threats with fewer, stronger vanilla or official-DLC pawn kinds while preserving each threat's tactical roles and special mechanics. An in-game audit page shows every before/after composition, tactical-identity proof, and safe fallback. It does not add hidden combat stat buffs.
通过使用派系原本拥有的高阶人类兵种、机械体型号或战术特征相近的官方动物，减少后期超大规模威胁的单位数量，同时保留每类袭击原有的职责与特殊机制。游戏内记录页面会显示压缩前后构成、战术身份验证与安全回退原因；不添加隐藏战斗属性 Buff。
